entities.summary: Alexandre Grenier is a Canadian professional ice hockey player. He is playing with Augsburger Panther of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Grenier was selected by the Vancouver Canucks in the 3rd round of the 2011 NHL Entry Draft.
